SUP-0041.name: Crestwood Furniture Manufacturing

performance.defect_rate_trend: INCREASING — current rate is 3.9x historical average

quality_incidents.description: Batch of 40 units reported with hairline fractures in support leg assembly. Attributed to change in leg joint adhesive formula. Supplier switched adhesive supplier in Q2 2024.
quality_incidents.resolution: Supplier issued credit note. Adhesive formula rolled back.
quality_incidents.notes: Logged by warehouse QC team. Not escalated to procurement or supplier relationship manager. Closed internally.

quality_incidents.description: 11 units returned by customers within 30 days of purchase for cracked or unstable leg assembly. Pattern not identified at intake — returns processed individually as isolated incidents.
quality_incidents.resolution: Individual refunds processed. No supplier notification sent.
quality_incidents.notes: Returns team processed individually. No cross-referencing with QI-2024-017. Pattern not recognised. No action taken with supplier.

open_purchase_orders.notes: Standard reorder. Placed before current damage pattern identified.

SUP-0041.recommendation: URGENT REVIEW REQUIRED. Current damage pattern in Southwest region is consistent with QI-2024-017 adhesive issue from June 2024. Prior incident was not escalated. A second batch of 200 units is currently in production (PO-2024-8821, delivery January 2025). If root cause is unresolved at supplier level, incoming stock will perpetuate the damage pattern. Recommend: (1) immediate hold on PO-2024-8821 pending quality confirmation, (2) formal supplier quality review with Crestwood, (3) escalation to Patricia Holloway and procurement leadership.
